# Filler Paper repository instructions

This is a set of instructions for working with the Filler Paper repository.

Filler Paper is a learning-first Software Engineering project and a product intended for real use.

Prefer small, incremental and maintainable changes.

Inspect relevant repository files before making assumptions about the current implementation.

When teaching, explain why before showing how.

Do not generate an entire feature when a smaller learning step is more appropriate.

Preserve the product philosophy:

> Capture first. Organize later.

Use the domain vocabulary and rules documented in the `understand-domain` skill.

Distinguish business rules from UI, persistence, framework and infrastructure decisions.
